change_interpretations.engineering_summary: The wording of the wheel‑speed loss requirement was changed but the functional intent (enter degraded mode and record a diagnostic event) remains identical, so verification objectives are unchanged.

assessments.reason: The test validates the accelerator‑torque response time (100 ms) defined in VCU-DR-01, which was not modified.
It checks pedal‑brake arbitration against VCU-DR-01 and VCU-BRK-03, both unchanged.
evidence: Procedure uses 85 % pedal, no timing claim

assessments.reason: The test has no linked requirement and exercises high‑load torque timing unrelated to the changed wheel‑speed requirement.
assessments.recommended_action: Keep test as is; no impact from spec change.

assessments.reason: Validates emergency‑brake latency per VCU-BRK-03, which is unchanged.
The functional behavior (switch to degraded mode and log a diagnostic event) is identical despite rewording of VCU-DGN-04.
evidence: Procedure matches both old and new text
assessments.recommended_action: Update test documentation to reference new wording if desired, but test execution remains valid.

assessments.reason: Logs mode change per VCU-LOG-05, which was not altered.
Requirement link is TBD, breaking traceability; relevance to the wheel‑speed change cannot be determined.
evidence: Workshop note flags TBD links as unvalidated
assessments.recommended_action: Clarify the intended requirement and ownership before deciding impact.

assessments.reason: Links to an unknown requirement (VCU-OLD-88); traceability is broken, so impact cannot be assessed.
assessments.recommended_action: Identify the current requirement that replaces VCU-OLD-88 and update the test record.

assessments.reason: Evaluates torque‑ramp profiles per VCU-MOD-06, which is unchanged.
Checks pedal‑spike filtering per VCU-DR-02, unchanged by the spec revision.
evidence: Procedure injects 7 ms pulse as per requirement

assessments.reason: Validates brake‑override priority defined in VCU-BRK-03, which is unchanged.
Tests ECU wake‑up timing; no link to the changed wheel‑speed requirement.
evidence: Procedure and result unrelated to VCU-DGN-04
